title: V5 migration dedup DELETE before UNIQUE INDEX handles pre-existing race duplicates
description: The V5 migration runs DELETE ... WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(rowid) ...) before DROP/CREATE UNIQUE INDEX. Without this, any database that had duplicate (chat_id, sender_msg_id) rows from the KITH-orvy.1 bug window would fail migration with a UNIQUE constraint error, bricking the user's store. MIN(rowid) is correct: the first-received row is canonical. A contributor might suggest removing the DELETE as 'unnecessary cleanup' — it is not cleanup, it is a prerequisite for the UNIQUE INDEX to apply at all on a live database.
